fusions.name: Angry Flight
fusions.desc: Snaps 3 stingers off the tip in a spread out to 6 tiles; each deals 3 damage, with a 25% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Smoked Out the Hive
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash and drives out a swarm for 12 seconds. Every second it stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Welts Like Stings
fusions.desc: Every hit you land raises a welt on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per welt (163% at full). Unfed, a welt fades every 4 seconds.
